_about: How names and recurring terms are written in this language, for the website now and the game's .po files later. World names (characters, places, coins, canon fish) come from HusbandOutWorld content/i18n/ko/glossary.json: the series wins, so if a spelling there changes, change it here too. Game-only names (fish made for this game) are added here.
rule: Story names in Hangul, by sound. This covers coined world terms too: creatures, plants, items, nari gels, spells, factions, guilds, places, ranks and coins (Wood People = 우드 피플, Sapphire = 사파이어, Bleed Out = 블리드 아웃). Parts of names are separated by spaces, as Korean writes foreign names (해리 산비, 아루키아 롱 브리지). Japanese-origin names follow the usual Korean spelling of Japanese (히로미, 다케오, 요스케). Plain words are translated (Nari Stones = 나리석, Black Honey = 검은 꿀). The currency balls is 볼 (사파이어 볼); the unit timehunk stays in Latin letters. Real people (Deovandski, Mitsukiven, Feiourm), the title and pets named in the afterwords (Peeta, Fluffy, Maddog) stay in Latin letters.
